instanceGeneralSettings.description: Configure instance-wide preferences including log display, keyboard shortcuts, backup retention, and data sharing.
instanceGeneralSettings.localTrustedModeDescription: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
instanceGeneralSettings.publicModeDescription: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
instanceGeneralSettings.privateModeDescription: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.
instanceGeneralSettings.censorUsernameDescription: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
instanceGeneralSettings.keyboardShortcutsDescription: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating tasks or toggling panels. This is off by default.
instanceGeneralSettings.backupRetentionDescription: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.
instanceGeneralSettings.aiFeedbackSharingDescription: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
instanceGeneralSettings.noDefaultSavedYet: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
instanceGeneralSettings.keepVotedOutputsLocal: Keep voted AI outputs local only.
instanceGeneralSettings.retestFirstUsePrompt: To retest the first-use prompt in local dev, remove the {{key}} key from the {{row}} JSON row for this instance, or set it back to {{prompt1}}. Unset and {{prompt2}} both mean no default has been chosen yet.
instanceGeneralSettings.signOutDescription: Sign out of this Paperclip instance. You will be redirected to the login page.
